meta.name: Cash Queens
meta.description: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

videos.title: A Tidy Sum
videos.overview: In dire need of money, best friends Rosalie and Kim decide to rob a bank. Along the way they pick up more partners in crime — and more problems.

videos.title: Lethal Weapons
videos.overview: With the cops and Ezéchiel determined to catch the bank thieves, Rosa's instructions not to spend any money go unheard as she tries to ditch the guns.

videos.title: On the Nose
videos.overview: Fresh off a second heist, Rosa fears that a trail of evidence could lead back to her. Mayor Marionnaud uses a funfair to put the squeeze on Ezéchiel.

videos.title: Thirty Million Friends
videos.overview: As Alex gets the gang ready for the Castel heist, Rosa starts to second-guess their plan. A fired-up Ezéchiel goes on the hunt for their getaway car.

videos.title: Gone in 30 Seconds
videos.overview: Sofia comes up with a genius storage solution, while her ex sees some compromising footage. Under pressure, Kim feeds Ezéchiel false information.

videos.title: Mission Almost Impossible
videos.overview: A lost suitcase causes even more stress for the gang. Victor's father puts Rosa to the test and Ezéchiel takes something very precious from Marionnaud.

videos.title: Breathless
videos.overview: The friends' getaway doesn't go as planned. As Sofia tries to throw Malik off Rosa's scent, Marionnaud pulls out the big guns and takes aim at Trévise.

videos.title: The Queens' Endgame
videos.overview: As the women defend Trévise like lionesses, Ezéchiel trains up his new crew and the police prepare a bust to take down the bank thieves - alive or dead.
